reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a senior secured loan of EUR 15 million to Egesil Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S., a manufacturer of specialty chemicals, to finance the company's new production facility in Sakarya, a Turkish province on the coast of Black Sea. The project involves financing the company's new production facility in Sakarya, Turkey which will increase precipitated silica capacity by 40,000 tons. The project is in line with the Bank's Green Economy Transition approach as 100 per cent of the EBRD's proceeds will be used for GET eligible investments.
